title: Worker event v1
description: One NDJSON line emitted by the worker: zero or more 'progress' events followed by exactly one 'result' event per request id. Sequence numbers start at 1 per request. SSDShredder.Worker.Protocol.RequestEmitter. IMPORTANT: a bare event carries no 'op' field, so its evidence shape can only be resolved by the consumer correlating 'id' back to the op it sent — see contracts/v1/evidence/*.schema.json for the four possible shapes and contracts/v1/README.md for how to pick the right one.

evidence.description: null, or one of contracts/v1/evidence/{inspect,shred,vault,probe}-evidence.schema.json depending on the request's op.
